svg.text: How a method moves between the tiers
JDK 25 defaults; the policy decides when a method's counters report in
trivial methods go here and stay
queue is longer than 5 x its threads
queue back to 2 x the threads,
deoptimisation: a guard failed; the method returns to the interpreter
and its profile keeps the trap and a decompile count
reports: every 128 calls interpreted, 2,048 at tier 2, 1,024 at tier 3
